Runtime dependencies: Qiskit, PennyLane, Gurobi/CP-SAT, Slurm, CUDA, CBOM tooling. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Quanta follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one optimization problem to a briefing. We will show the bench, the baseline and the benchmark plan it would run under.
